description: Retrieve a single wakeup by ID. Use this inside a Claude routine prompt: the routine fires, calls `get_wakeup({ id: 'abc-123' })`, gets the full context and benchmarks, then runs the analysis. Also auto-marks the wakeup as triggered if the trigger date has passed.
